nodes.description: Public address state variable 'owner' initialized from msg.sender at deployment; used as the authority reference in the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable 'last_completed_migration' tracking the highest migration index that has been completed.
Caller-controlled msg.sender; used both to initialize owner and to authorize calls in the restricted modifier.
Public function setCompleted(uint completed) guarded by the 'restricted' modifier; writes the supplied value into last_completed_migration.
Modifier 'restricted' that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the modified function body.
Input parameter 'completed' of setCompleted; carries the new migration index supplied by the caller.
State write 'last_completed_migration = completed' inside setCompleted; mutates persistent contract state.
Access-control check 'require(msg.sender == owner)' inside the restricted modifier; reverts non-owner callers.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable at construction, so the privileged identity originates from caller-controlled input.
The require comparison consumes msg.sender directly to decide whether the caller is authorized.
The require comparison reads the owner state variable as the trusted reference value for authorization.
The owner check in the restricted modifier gates execution of setCompleted and reverts when it fails.
Modifier 'restricted' is applied to setCompleted, wrapping its body with the ownership check.
Execution of setCompleted leads to the state write of last_completed_migration.
Parameter 'completed' is the value written into the state variable by the assignment.
The assignment updates the last_completed_migration state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter 'completed' has no independent behavior; it only feeds the state write of last_completed_migration, so it can be merged into that unsafe operation.
